localizedText.DESC_FOLDER_RECIPETYPE: Folder for recipe types and/or folders
localizedText.DESC_RECIPE: Recipes are based on recipe types
localizedText.DESC_RECIPE_LOCKED: Locks the recipe. Locked recipes cannot be activated or modified.
localizedText.DESC_RECIPETYPE: Recipe type is a general description of a set of symbols
localizedText.DESC_VERSIONING_ENABLED: Enable version tracking for recipes. This option can only be changed when no recipes or recipe types are configured.
localizedText.NESTED_RECIPE_REQUIRES_VERSION: Nested recipe reference must include a version (e.g. 'RecipeName::v1') when versioning is enabled.
localizedText.RECIPE_LOCKED: The recipe is locked and cannot be modified or activated.
localizedText.RECIPETYPE_CONTAINS_LOCKED_RECIPES: The recipe type cannot be modified because it is referenced by locked recipes.
localizedText.RECIPE_REFERENCED_BY_LOCKED_RECIPE: The recipe cannot be modified because it is referenced by a locked recipe.
localizedText.VERSIONING_CHANGE_REQUIRES_EMPTY_CONFIG: Versioning can only be enabled or disabled when no recipes or recipe types are configured.
localizedText.VERSIONING_BLACKLISTED_NAME: The name pattern 'v' followed by digits (v1, v2, etc.) is reserved for versions and cannot be used for folders or recipe types.
